name: Romanian deadlift (dumbbell)
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs.
Push your hips back and lower the dumbbells down your shins.
Keep your back flat and knees only slightly bent.
Drive your hips forward to stand back up.
cue: Push hips back, keep the back flat
mistakes: Letting the dumbbells drift away from the legs.
